_comment: Prompt rules (`rules:` in a skill's prompt.yaml). A rule with `tools` joins the system header when one of its tools is in this prompt (`present`: the prompt's tools, internal ones left out); a `when: many` rule joins when the request asks for many files (knaif.nl_clarify_gate.asks_for_many_files). Rules join in their order, each after the header's last line: the header's trailing newlines are dropped, then a newline, then the rule's text as written. No rule applies: the header is unchanged. Python `knaif.prompt.apply_prompt_rules`, Rust `knaif_core::prompt::apply_prompt_rules`. A rule with `words` (owner, 2026-10-23) joins only when the request also holds one of them: a whole word, any case, or for CJK a substring; with `tools`, both must hold.

rules.text: - MANY FILES: write the steps for one file.
- THE LAST N SECONDS: a negative start counts back from the end.
